title: RBS-Attention：面向长上下文大模型的半径约束稀疏预填充
summary: 提出免训练的稀疏预填充方法 RBS-Attention，通过质心基分支与救援分支的双分支选择缓解均值稀释问题，在 H100 上实现最高 20.65 倍预填充注意力加速，并在 RULER 等基准上保持接近稠密注意力的质量。
summary_en: RBS-Attention is a training-free sparse-prefill method with dual selection branches (centroid base and rescue) to mitigate mean dilution. It achieves up to 20.65x prefill-attention speedup on H100 while maintaining near-dense quality on RULER and other long-context benchmarks.
